jobs.description: About Allianz Global InvestorsAllianz Global Investors is a leading active asset manager, managing assets for individuals, families, and institutions worldwide. Their needs inspire our thinking and guide our actions.  Together, we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and confident to explore, grow and shape a better future - for our clients and for the world around us. As AI moves into everyday investment and business processes, our ambition is for AI applications and agents to work from enterprise data and context that is understandable, traceable and used only where permitted - so their output is accurate, explainable and safe to rely on.This role leads the development of the capability that makes this possible: the framework, standards and ways of working that connect our data and business context to AI, end to end - and its adoption across the firm.This position will be based in Munich or Frankfurt.What you will do- Own and evolve the capability - the framework that brings together business meaning, data, governance and AI-usage context so enterprise data becomes usable, and trustworthy, for AI- Build the creation and ownership model - enable business functions to create and maintain the context AI relies on, and set the guidelines they follow- Govern how context is used - ensure the right access, classification and governance are applied, set the standards data and context must meet before AI can use them, and define how AI is guided to the most relevant context- Design how AI consumes trusted context - curate the context, instructions and feedback loops behind AI use cases, and decide with platform engineering what is exposed to AI and how it is governed and ranked- Drive adoption across the firm - roll the model out to business areas, encourage and enable users, and build the training that makes it stick- Sustain it over time - keep a living library of context current as usage grows, and measure whether context is genuinely improving AI outcomes and implement a lean operating model- Keep it compliant and connected - ensure that our governance meets EU regulatory expectations (DORA, the EU AI Act, GDPR), and partner closely with legal, data, platform engineering and business teamsWhat you bringEssential- A track record of building and scaling a capability or operating model across a large, complex organisation - ideally in data governance, data management, knowledge management or AI enablement - coaching and influencing teams that retain ownership, rather than relying on formal authority- Data governance and regulatory knowledge (DORA, EU AI Act, GDPR) and how these apply to the use of data by AI- A good understanding of data modelling and semantics / ontologies, and why they matter for making data AI-ready- Conceptual fluency in generative AI and retrieval, sufficient to design and govern how AI consumes context (building the pipelines is done by platform engineering)- Familiarity with a modern data platform such as Databricks / Unity Catalog - governance, lineage, classification and metadata- Excellent stakeholder management, communication and enablement - able to make technical concepts accessible and to build adoption across business and technical teamsDesirable- Experience in asset management or financial services- Experience standing up and scaling a governance, knowledge or enablement capability- Hands-on experience with ontology tooling and metadata / catalogue platforms and/or data contextWhat we offer- We empower our employees by ensuring flexible work arrangements that maintain a balance between performance, productivity, career development and personal priorities (e.g., hybrid model/ flexible working hours)- Securing your future: Access to company pension/savings plans- Family support (relocation/ childcare facilities)- Company share purchasing plan- Mental health and wellbeing programs- Mobility solutions (Jobrad bike leasing, subvention Jobticket)- Career opportunities within the entire Allianz Group- Self-guided learning & development- Volunteering time- … and so much more!

jobs.description: The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.The DKFZ is a place where the brightest minds pursue bold ideas and seek answers to pioneering scientific questions through collaboration, innovation, and exploration across many disciplines. We provide a dynamic environment which empowers excellence with state-of-the-art technologies, cutting edge infrastructure, and a global scientific network. Contribute your knowledge, vision, and dedication to create a space where scientific discovery in cancer research is transformed into benefits for human health.Together with selected university partner sites, the DKFZ has established the German Cancer Consortium (DKTK) (https://dktk.dkfz.de/en) . The alliance between the DKFZ as the core center and the university partner sites in Berlin, Dresden, Essen/Düsseldorf, Frankfurt/Mainz, Freiburg, Heidelberg, Munich, and Tübingen operates joint translation centers at the University Medical Centers of each of the selected partner sites. The DKTK contributes significantly to filling the translational gap between basic and clinical cancer research, thereby developing new strategies for personalized oncology in prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of cancer. DKTK conducts transformative translational cancer research, educates the next generation of translation-oriented medical and clinical scientists and establishes strong pipelines towards clinical cancer research and the economy.At the DKTK partner site Freiburg, we are offering, starting at the earliest date possible, a Postdoc Position in Preclinical Development of Bicyclic Peptides for Nuclear Medicine.The Division of Radiopharmaceutical Development at DKTK Freiburg focuses on the development and clinical translation of novel radiopharmaceuticals for molecular imaging and targeted radionuclide therapy. A key emphasis is on radiotheranostics, from the identification of new targets and tumor-targeting compounds to preclinical evaluation and first-in-human translation.The position is located at the University Medical Center Freiburg, Department of Nuclear Medicine (www.uniklinik-freiburg.de/nuklearmedizin/radiopharmakaentwicklung).Your TasksThe position is part of a long-term collaboration with the company Bicycle Therapeutics (https://www.bicycletherapeutics.com/)  and covers the preclinical characterization of novel bicyclic peptides for clinical translation. This established and successful research platform includes the identification and evaluation of novel radiopharmaceuticals for positron emission tomography (PET) and radionuclide therapy. The relationship between DKFZ and Bicycle Therapeutics has expanded to include a more continuous and purpose-driven commitment towards advancing candidates towards the clinic. The current project aims at the preclinical development and clinical translation of novel radiolabeled, tumor-targeting bicyclic peptide conjugates for diagnostic and therapeutic application in nuclear medicine. The bicyclic peptide conjugates are synthesized by solid phase synthesis and modified by bioconjugation chemistry. Finally, the conjugates are labeled with several clinically relevant radioisotopes for in vitro and in vivo evaluation. Your task is to elaborate the scientific data within this work plan and to communicate the results with our collaboration partner. Your Profile- Master's degree and PhD in biochemistry, chemistry or pharmacy or equivalent- Experience in peptide chemistry and related analytical methods- Experience in biological assays and in vivo experiments would be advantageous- Good communication skills in English- Motivation to work in an interdisciplinary team- Interest in application-oriented / translational researchTo apply, please submit a brief cover letter stating your motivation, a curriculum vitae as well as certified copies of your university degrees with grades (BA and MA certificate / Diploma / PhD certificate) and contact details of two referees via our online application portal.We Offer- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level- Remuneration according to TV-L incl. occupational pension plan and capital-forming payments- 30 days of vacation per year- Flexible working hours- Possibility of mobile work and part-time work- Family-friendly working environment- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-being- Develop your full potential: access to the DKFZ International Postdoc Program and DKFZ Career Service with targeted offers for your personal development to further develop your talentsAre you interested?Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!Contact:Prof. Dr. Matthias EderPhone: +49 761270 74220Duration: The position is initially limited to 2 years with the possibility of prolongation.Application Deadline: November 05, 2026Applications by e-mail cannot be accepted.Please also note that we cannot return applications submitted by post.We are convinced that an innovative research and working environment thrives on the diversity of its employees. Therefore, we welcome applications from talented people, regardless of gender, cultural background, nationality, ethnicity, sexual identity, physical ability, religion and age. People with severe disabilities are given preference if they have the same aptitude.Notice: We are subject to the regulations of the Infection Protection Act (IfSG). Therefore, all our employees must provide proof of immunity against measles.

We offer a PhD position in the research group of Dr. Frederik Kotz-Helmer, which is embedded within the NeptunLab led by Prof. Bastian E. Rapp at the Department of Microsystems Engineering (IMTEK), University of Freiburg. NeptunLab is a highly interdisciplinary research environment focusing on the development of novel materials, manufacturing technologies, and processes for industrial applications. Research from the NeptunLab has been published in leading international journals, including Lab on a Chip, Advanced Materials, Angewandte Chemie, and Nature, and has received attention from national and international media outlets such as the BBC, The New York Times, and the Discovery Channel.Glass is an essential engineering material for applications ranging from optics and photonics to microtechnology and high-performance components. However, conventional glass manufacturing technologies strongly limit the geometries that can be produced and often require complex and energy-intensive processing routes.Within this PhD project, a novel extrusion-based manufacturing technology for glass will be developed. The approach is based on highly filled thermoplastic nanocomposites containing silica nanoparticles dispersed in a polymeric binder system. These materials are shaped in the polymeric state by extrusion and subsequently converted into dense, transparent glass through debinding and sintering.A major focus of the project will be the development of thermoplastic nanocomposites with tailored rheological and mechanical properties. Polymer composition, molecular weight, particle loading, particle dispersion, and processing conditions will be systematically investigated to establish relationships between material formulation, flow behavior, extrusion stability, and the geometry of the resulting components. Structured extrusion dies will be used to directly manufacture complex cross-sectional geometries, providing a new route toward continuous manufacturing of structured glass components.The successful candidate will work at the interface of materials science, polymer processing, rheology, nanocomposites, and glass technology. The project combines fundamental materials research with the development of a new manufacturing process and therefore provides substantial freedom for both scientific investigation and technology development.Developing highly filled thermoplastic silica nanocomposites for extrusion-based glass manufacturing.Designing polymer binder systems with tailored rheological, mechanical, and debinding properties.Developing and optimizing extrusion processes for complex and microstructured geometries.Investigating the relationship between extrusion parameters, die geometry, material flow, and dimensional accuracy.Designing and evaluating structured extrusion dies for the continuous manufacturing of complex glass components.Characterizing nanocomposites and glasses using techniques such as SEM, XRD, FTIR, Raman spectroscopy, rheology, thermal analysis, and optical characterization.Establishing quantitative material-process-structure relationships for extrusion-based glass manufacturing.Presenting research results at international conferences and publishing findings in peer-reviewed journals.Master’s degree/Bachelor’s degree/Studies in Material Science, Mechanical Engineering, Process Engineering or related subjectsProfound knowledge of polymer chemistry, material science and processing is requiredKnowledge of glass science, ceramic processing or polymer extrusion are/is beneficial.Excellent academic track recordExcellent English skills in reading and writingYou should be a team player with ambitions who can conduct research projects independentlyYou should be able to structure and document your work properlyYou should be a creative mind without causing excessive chaos around youAn interdisciplinary work environment with a team of motivated scientists that strive to develop clever solu...

experience with automated systems is an advantage as well as experience with SQL- Successfully led and implemented projects, ideally combined with experience in Lean Management- Flexibility to work temporarily in Wohlen and later at the new logistics center in Neuenburg, along with approximately 20% travel within Switzerland- Fluent in English and German, French is an advantage- The capacity to adapt to ongoing changes in the work environment- Identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing changes to enhance productivity and effectivenessWarum startest du bei uns?- Values, not empty words: Cooperative, innovative, piratesque, responsible, ambitious – these five values are what we practise and preach- Courageous thinking: We encourage everyone to think on their feet, and love it when they come up with bold or edgy ideas- Uncomplicated approach: Simplicity is at our core. We avoid the unnecessary and focus on what really matters – from overcoming challenges to celebrating our shared successes- Flexibility and freedom: Every position is possible with an 80% workload- Rapid growth: With us, growth is a continuous journey. We also support you with EDU points (https://www.galaxus.de/en/page/more-training-sign-me-up-20943)  (1600 € and 2000 minutes) per year for your professional development so there’s no risk of you getting stuck in a rut- More benefits: 28 days of holiday, exclusive employee conditions in our online shop, a shuttle service and other benefitsDiversity is our culture.To build the best team, we want to draw from the full spectrum of talent out there. This means people from all walks of life have the same opportunities with us, regardless of their ethnicity, religion, disability status, gender identity, sexual orientation or age. We believe true inclusion means everyone is welcome and each contribution is valuable.

Requisition ID: 1616743

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence?
Working together to make the world a little bit better every day. This is our purpose at EY and as a team we go all in to work towards our bold ambition: to create long-term value and growth – for our clients, our people and society. Our network of around 400,000 people around the world offers you every opportunity to grow, develop, specialize and pursue your professional strengths and interests. We believe that the right career path is as individual as you are.

Your role
As part of our Platform, Solutions and Intelligence Team within a European center of excellence in Stuttgart or Munich you will consult multinational clients in cross-border and complex problems. You will take on a wide variety of tasks:

- Conception and implementation of digital transformation projects with a focus on accounting and reporting processes as well as intercompany accounting within the SAP S/4HANA environment
- Consulting of the finance organization to implement efficient finance processes as well as digitalization of business processes in NextGen-ERP-systems – from strategy development, concept preparation and process design to the optimization and implementation
- Specialized consulting services in an international environment to solve complex problems in in-house accounting, interlocked with the respective logistics, controlling and accounting processes
- Involvement in the development of innovative services and preparation of turnkey solutions for clients
- Responsibilities for project progress and technical leadership of teams

Your skillset

- University degree in economics and several years of relevant experience in consulting and collaboration with substantial, complex clients; ideally with a specialization in intercompany accounting and operational transfer pricing issues
- Deep understanding of functional problems in internal and cross-border processes
- Very good application and implementation capabilities in one or more of the following technologies: SAP S/4HANA, SAP Central Finance, SAP Module FI/CO, SAP PaPM, Blackline produccts, Anaplan; Exceptional communication skills in German and English

Your mindset

- Agile: You believe that a flexible mindset is just as important for success as knowledge and skills.
- Curious: You are ambitious and committed. We are looking for people who recognize opportunities, proactively tackle challenges, and find better solutions by asking targeted questions.
- Collaborative : You value diverse perspectives and enjoy working in a team. We are looking for people to help us shape the future and create a working environment based on trust.

Your benefits
At EY, you will work in high-performing, interdisciplinary teams with innovative technologies. We support you in your various life situations with our flexible and inclusive working environment. Inspiring colleagues as well as training and development opportunities both on and off the job will empower you to grow and develop skills that will equip you for the future. We guarantee a steep learning curve.  <>More about our benefits  .

Apply today!
You can find further information on the application process at EY on our Careers page  .
At EY, we emb  diversity and welcome all applications. Let us know in good time if we can help you by offering an accessible application process.
Any questions? Just call +49 6196 996 10005 and our Recruitment Center will be happy to help.

Account Executive/Sales (m/f/d)München, HybridFull-timePermanent employeeRoleHive Robotics is building Europe’s first full-stack orchestration platform for unmanned systems: connecting, controlling, and commanding multi-vendor drone and robot swarms. Our RF communication systems are Made in Germany, deployed on active frontlines, and targeting a highly valued tactical communication market with zero sovereign alternatives today.As our first dedicated Account Executive, you own the sales pipeline: every opportunity from a lead to a signed contract. You take over our existing customer accounts and drive the opportunities our founders and Business Development have opened, with the first new deals expected to close within 3 months. You currently report to the CEO.This role is customer-facing by design: expect 30–50% travel to customer sites, procurement offices, partners and trade fairs across Germany and Europe, sometimes internationally. The rest of the time you work alongside Engineering, Product Management and our Field Application Engineers.Responsibilities- Own the funnel from the first qualified conversation to signature. Our founders and Business Development open doors with customers, partners and the wider ecosystem. From there the opportunity is yours: you qualify it, drive it and close it, pulling the founders back in only when a deal needs them. Leads you generate yourself count just as much, this isn't exclusively BD's territory.- Qualify hard and early. Run discovery against a fixed gate (pain, budget, decision-making unit, timing) before we invest engineering time in a technical deep dive, and keep a clear next step with a date on every opportunity.- Lead the customer's buying team through a hardware buying cycle: end users, engineers, procurement, legal and IT, across long evaluations, equipment trials run as projects, integration questions and security reviews.- Orchestrate the deal team. Bring in our engineers and Field Application Engineers for demos, trials and technical deep dives, and Product Management for configuration and fit. You decide when a deal needs them and what they're there to do.- Own our active customers commercially: account plans, follow-on orders, upsells and expansion into new units and use cases, every escalation that touches the relationship, and regular account reviews with the Field Application Engineer who owns adoption.- Turn deployed systems into the next deal: reference visits, customer quotes and case material that you or the founders can use to open new accounts.- Own the offer: configuration and pricing, terms and conditions, the cost-benefit case on the customer's own data, and the project plan to signature. Lead our responses to RFPs and tenders where they apply, and build the templates so every proposal starts from a proven base.- Get a trial agreement signed before any trial starts: scope, duration, success criteria, pilot price and the path to the main contract. You drive it, Operations owns the paperwork.- Close, and hand over cleanly. Request the contract from Operations, keep the customer and the internal side moving, and sign. Then hand over to Operations as a confirmed customer order and to the Field Application Engineer for onboarding.- Keep the pipeline honest: stage discipline, forecast and CRM hygiene, and a weekly pipeline review you run for the foundersRequirementsMust Have- 7+ years in B2B sales of technical products into complex, multi-stakeholder deals, ideally in a scale up company- You have sold hardware, or hardware combined with software and firmware: physical systems with configurations, lead times, integration work and delivery commitments behind them- Comfortable selling to technical and non-technical stakeholders in the same room, and knowing when to bring in the engineers- Hands-on daily work in a CRM and a disciplined qualification method (e.g. MEDDPICC): your forecast is something the company can plan on- Closer's mindset: you treat an opportunity without a next step and a date as a problem, not a pipeline entry- Structured working style: your offers, decisions and customer commitments are written down so that Operations, the field team and the founders can act on them without asking- Willingness to travel 30–50 % across Germany and Europe, occasionally beyond Europe- Fluent English (German is a very big plus)- Eligibility and willingness to undergo security vetting for access to some customer sitesNice to Have- An existing network or experience selling to the DACH defense ecosystem: armed forces, procurement offices, primes, integrators- Technical fluency in RF communication, embedded systems, unmanned systems, command-and-control or robotics- Experience building a sales pipeline or sales function from scratch rather than inheriting oneÜber unsWe work in deep-tech and dual-use technology, an industry where women and other underrepresented groups have historically had limited access. We encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box below.Why Hive- Build sovereign technology that matters. We build RF communication and orchestration systems for unmanned platforms across air, land, sea, and space, at a moment when European technological sovereignty is a real strategic question, not an abstract one.- Real ownership, real deployment. Our products are already in serial production and in the field. What you build ships, and you see the result.- Small team, direct access. Around 30 people. You'll work directly with founders and not through multiple layers of management.- You shape the foundations. We're still building the structures, career paths, controlling, compliance, that let a fast-growing company scale well. You'll help decide what they look like.- Modern Munich office, with the tools and equipment to do your best work.What You Get- **Compensation. **We benchmark salaries to stay competitive for the market and the role, not just what an early-stage budget can spare.- Equity. You participate in Hive through equity/VSOP, a genuine stake in what we build, not just a paycheck.- A role you shape, not one you're handed. We're too early for fixed job descriptions or a career ladder. What you own grows as you take on more, not by climbing steps someone else defined.- No bureaucracy. Small, flat team. Decisions happen in a conversation, not a sign-off chain.Compensation and equity terms vary by role and level.Hive Robotics is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of race, ethnic origin, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or marital status. Please don't include data on ethnic origin, political views, religious beliefs, union membership, health, or sexual orientation in your application.Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: CRM-Systeme
